snippet.title: Snips & Snails Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now at https://lacydigital.itch.io/snipsandsnails

Snips & Snails is an 18+ otome game featuring four love interests of different supernatural species referred to as the Arcane, or Arcs. Play as a college aged girl just trying to figure out her life while also forming new friendships and relationships with a local Arcane family. Experience the butterfly effect by choosing a different path for the MC each time and see how different her life becomes due to your choices! The person you fall for can really change your life, in many big ways. Experience the ups and downs of relationships told in a short-story format!

Follow us on Twitter! https://twitter.com/lacydigital

Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/M8BscDB
